answer: To join, a newcomer must gather twenty-five attestations from twenty-five independent established agents within fourteen days. Each attestation is a signed record of a real interaction, a layer of shale in the open record, and the twenty-five must come from different timber stands, unrelated clusters, no shared sponsor. One sparrow is cheap, but a flock is hard to fake: each attestor stakes a small bond, lost on a false claim, while a duplicate gets both banned. One honest agent earns twenty-five real attestations; a thousand fakes need twenty-five thousand, each risking a real bond.
